segments.he:
פרשת שופטים בונה חברה של משפט צדק, סמכות תורה, מלכות שפלה, תמימות עם ה׳ ואומץ במלחמה. המשפט משיב כל דבר למקומו; הצדיק והחכמים מבררים אמת, מגינים מפני דמיון וכישוף, ומוליכים את ישראל לחיים, שלום וירושת הארץ.

משפט צדק → סמכות התורה → ענוות המלך → תמימות ואמת → אומץ במלחמה → שלום, חיים וארץ־ישראל
segments.en:
Parashas Shoftim builds a society of righteous judgment, Torah authority, humble kingship, wholeheartedness with Hashem, and courage in battle. Judgment returns each matter to its proper place; the tzaddik and sages clarify truth, protect against imagination and sorcery, and lead Israel toward life, peace, and inheritance of the Land.

Righteous judgment → Torah authority → the king’s humility → wholeheartedness and truth → courage in battle → peace, life, and Eretz Yisrael

segments.en: You shall be blameless with Hashem your God. The principle of perfection is emunah alone. Therefore, emunah is called innocence in the test of innocence. You shall be blameless with Hashem your God. For emunah is innocent and perfect in the measure of perfection. For all things shall fail. No one shall be able to speak. The eye shall not be satisfied with seeing, nor shall the ear be filled with hearing. And so on. And even if the wise man says, "I know," he will not be able to find it. And therefore there is no perfection in knowledge and the Torah, because it is in the hands of emunah. For it is impossible to attain by knowledge a thing of perfection, because if it is in the hands of a believer, which is from another, because emunah

"Blessed is he who is tzaddik and in his mitzvos, blessed is he who has perfect emunah, he is perfect in the perfection of perfection, for emunah is without limit, for he believes in the truth that he is eternal, even though it is impossible to attain it in knowledge, even though it is impossible to attain it in any way, but emunah encompasses all things eternally and completely." segments.en: You shall not take away the border of your neighbor, who, knowing that the border is like one, shall have a portion for him in the Eretz Yisrael, for every one of Israel shall have a portion for him in the Eretz Yisrael, because the principle of knowledge is to know by whom he will be blessed in the Eretz Yisrael, where the holy house is, which is holy knowledge for the name that extends throughout the Eretz Yisrael. In all the light of the Holy House, as is known, and therefore the Eretz Yisrael is filled with wisdom, and there is no wisdom like the wisdom of the Eretz Yisrael, for there is the essence of knowing the Holy One. To recognize Him is to be blessed, as our late rabbis said: The whole house

segments.en: In the Eretz Yisrael, it is like someone who has God, etc. And each one of Israel is like his root and like his work, in attaining this knowledge to his border, just as he has a portion in the Eretz Yisrael. And in this way they will strive and reach the abundance of each one of Israel, that he may have an inheritance and a great portion. In the Eretz Yisrael, as is evident from many places, everything is on the path to achieving the rest of this holy knowledge that is in the inheritance of the Eretz Yisrael. Your friend, Gebul, do not withdraw from this inheritance that is in your inheritance, in the rest that we have warned you about in the Eretz Yisrael.

segments.en: Our rabbis, who said, "And it is written in Parosh Rashi," because there is the principle of the prohibition of trespassing on the boundary of one's neighbor, that one should not destroy and gather with one's knowledge in the boundary of one's neighbor, because through this one can come close to destroying peace and security, to destroy and spoil his knowledge to the uttermost of peace and security. Therefore, every person must be careful. In his companionship, he will be able to do much, even though it is a great mitzvah to speak to his companion at all times with fear and defects, to bring up his sins and to have mercy on his sins and his faults, because this is the essence of the restoration of the world and so on.

segments.en: And since it is written in the Torah, 'For He has mercy on them' (Likkutei Tinina-Siman 7, Ayen Sham), it is necessary to be very careful that the business be for good and not for evil, to build and not to destroy, leaving peace and harmony, that no division or hatred will arise from this peace and harmony, because most quarrels and quarrels and hatred are prolonged. Therefore, what is the use of a person who is not beautiful in the eyes of his friend and sees in him many defects and evils until it seems to him that it is impossible to bear them? And it was very many of our ancestors (a day separated by seven days) who burned down my house because of the hatred of Hanim, which came from the hands of the above, from the hands of the one who was able to control his friend. Because truly, Let us judge every person according to their rights, as our rabbis, the late, said: "Do not judge your friend until he reaches his place. For he who knows how to reach his friend's place is like the limit of his friend's knowledge, from which they have continued and expanded."

When a wise man examines the gates of the high place, each one knows what a gate has hidden in its heart, and this is impossible to tell to his friend. And even for himself, it is impossible to tell a story about a day to his friend as he writes in his "Shichothar" at the beginning, "Ayen Sham."

For this is the attainment of God in the performance of a Merkabah, because the narrowings that are on the Yadalekot for the attainment of the Merkabah, as written at the beginning of the Torah, are a sign for the performance of a Merkabah.

segments.en: Therefore, although it is a great mitzvah to speak with one's neighbor, he will be blessed, and to know the Holy One in my knowledge, yet it is necessary to be in the test of will and return, because only by speaking of His wonders will one be blessed, as it is written: "They will speak of all His wonders," for by this emunah is strengthened. The Holy One, as it is written: "To all generations I will make known your emunahfulness." And it is written: "As surely as I live, he knows you, and the father of children will know your emunahfulness." For it is a great mitzvah that everyone should tell his neighbor of the wonderful works of Hashem, the blessed one, that he has done for him.

segments.en: Therefore it is said: "You shall go alone and no stranger shall come with you" (from the parable of the sower). Therefore, the wise men have a reason for the above-mentioned silent wisdom that the boundary should not be destroyed, and just as the Torah and the Ascent of the Torah were warned earlier, "You and Aaron and the priests and the people shall not be destroyed in ascending to Hashem, and the Ascent of the Torah shall not be destroyed." And Rashi explains there: "You are a half For yourself and Aaron, for yourself and the whole people, do not destroy them, and so on. For each one has a unique limit, the limit for destruction that is forbidden in his knowledge.

segments.he: לא יקום עד אחד באיש לכל עון ולכל חטאת בפרוד וסים בחבורא שרי הסטרא־אחראא, הקדוש בזהר כמובא להפך הוא והקדשה.כי הסטרא אחרא,שהם הנחש והשקר,הם מתחילין בחבור,שאומרים:אור שלמעלה הוא מחבר יחד, להמשיכו ולחלקו לצמצמו אפשר ואילמטה, כפירה שהוא גמור בפרוד מסימין ועל־ידי־זה גמורה,כי אינם מאמינים שכל החיות של מטה, הכל קשור ומחבר למעלה,וכאלו זה העולם נפרד, חס ושלום, העליון משר
segments.en: No one will rise up against a man for every evil and every sin, in separation and ending with the union of the two great satras. The holy in the Zohar is translated as the opposite of the holy. For the last satras, which are the false and the false, begin with the union, as they say: The light that is from above is joined together, to extend and divide it. To reduce it, it is possible to say that Wilmata, as a heretic, is complete in the separation of the two, and on the other hand, it is complete, because they do not believe that all living things are of the same order, everything is connected and connected to the higher, and as if this world were separate, peace and blessings, the higher is from Hashem.

segments.en: The Holy One, however, remains in the realm of separation, which separates and divides the thousands into hundreds of light and dims them, a knowing emunah that prepares for the Holy One, and connects this physical world with Him, which is all for His glory, because His kingdom is in every government. And this is the principle of the perfection of the Oneness, when it is known that all living things and the behavior of All the details of creation, all connected and connected in Him, will be blessed, for He will be blessed, giving life to them all. And this is: "And they will end in union."

segments.en: And he said: "Let no one witness stand against a man for every iniquity and every sin, etc." They were from the sitra achra who ruled and held the filth of the brass from which all iniquity and every sin and the cry to choose the truth from there, therefore it is impossible for a single witness to stand, because there is no power in him to stand against the other punishment that is stronger than not sharing the light.
